warnings: All 30 buyer SKUs were matched to vendor line items by size (inches) and ply; no unmatched vendor lines remain.

Vendor pricing sheet shows 'Rate/Box (Rs.)' as ex-GST base price and a separate 'GST 18% (Rs.)' column plus 'Rate incl. GST (Rs.)'; per extraction rules the ex-GST 'Rate/Box' value was recorded with tax_included=false for all lines.
Vendor T&C item 6 states 'Quantity tolerance +/- 10%' applies generally to all quoted quantities/prices - not captured per-line, buyer should note this applies document-wide.

For printed SKUs, vendor Notes sheet states printing plates/cylinders are charged extra, one-time, Rs.3,500 per colour - this is not included in the per-box rate and should be added to landed cost calculations.

CB-029 vendor line describes the partition cell configuration as '3x4 cells' whereas the buyer SKU list specifies '4x3 cells'; dimensions match exactly (15.7x11.8x7.9 in / 400x300x200 mm) so likely the same item, but orientation/grid naming should be confirmed with vendor before order placement.

Vendor quotes for CB-027 and CB-028 (layer pads/sheets) and CB-029/CB-030 (partitions) use the same 'Rate/Box' column header as boxes; unit was recorded as written ('per box') though these are sheet/set items - buyer should confirm this rate basis directly with vendor if ambiguous.
